question: Depending upon carbon and moisture content which is the highest and lowest quality of coal respectively?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anthracite, lignite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Anthracite is the **highest quality coal, and ** l**ignite**** is the lo**west quality coal, based on their carbon and moisture content
 
• The** highest quality coal with the highest carbon content (90–98%**) and **low moisture content (7–10%). **
 
• It's a hard, brittle, black, and lustrous coat
 
• **Anthracite****​**
 
 
• Anthracite contains 86%–97% carbon and generally has the highest heating value of all ranks of coal.
 
 
 
• Lignite 
 
 
• It **contains 25%–35% carbon and has the lowest energy** content of all coal ranks.
 
• Lignite
